validated_results.title: Dietary vitamins E and C and prostate cancer risk.
validated_results.reason: Hospital-based case-control study reporting an odds ratio for dietary vitamin C intake and incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer.

extraction.comparison_type: highest versus lowest tertile of intake
extraction.location: major teaching and general hospitals of five Italian areas
extraction.population: Men with incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer and hospital controls admitted for acute, non-neoplastic conditions

sample_size.excerpt: Cases were 1 294 men with incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer, admitted to the major teaching and general hospitals of five Italian areas between 1991 and 2002. Controls were 1 451 men admitted for acute, non-neoplastic conditions to the same hospitals.
sample_size.location: abstract methods; total_n derived from reported group counts 1294 + 1451 = 2745

cases.excerpt: Cases were 1 294 men with incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer, admitted to the major teaching and general hospitals of five Italian areas between 1991 and 2002.

effect_size.excerpt: Vitamin E showed a significant inverse association with prostate cancer (OR = 0.78 for the highest versus the lowest tertile of intake, 95% CI: 0.58-0.96; p-value for trend = 0.02), whereas for vitamin C the inverse association was of borderline statistical significance (OR = 0.86; 95% CI: 0.65-1.08).

confidence_interval.excerpt: Vitamin E showed a significant inverse association with prostate cancer (OR = 0.78 for the highest versus the lowest tertile of intake, 95% CI: 0.58-0.96; p-value for trend = 0.02), whereas for vitamin C the inverse association was of borderline statistical significance (OR = 0.86; 95% CI: 0.65-1.08).

comparison.excerpt: Odds ratios (OR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) for increasing levels of vitamin intake were estimated

design.excerpt: a case-control study was carried out to investigate the role of dietary intake of vitamins E and C in the etiology of prostate cancer

timing.excerpt: admitted to the major teaching and general hospitals of five Italian areas between 1991 and 2002

location.excerpt: major teaching and general hospitals of five Italian areas

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Information on dietary habits and nutrient intake was elicited using a validated food frequency questionnaire including 78 food groups and recipes.
